name: Astraea no Zaikyuu
source:
Your partner’s disappearance. The suspiciously abrupt termination of the investigation…

The trail of suspicion leads you to the 11th Intelligence Investigation Office (commonly known as “ELEVEN”)

A web of mysteries. Major incident that threatens to shake the nation to its core

When every clue finally connects, revealing the bigger picture:

What future will you, the detective, choose? The scales of choice are now in your hands
translation:
搭档的离奇失踪，以及戛然而止得令人生疑的调查……

重重疑云的线索，最终将你引向了“第11情报调查室”（通称“ELEVEN”）。

错综复杂的谜团，足以动摇国家根基的重大案件。

当所有线索终于串联成形、揭开背后的全貌之时——

身为刑警的你，将会选择怎样的未来？抉择的天平，如今已交到你的手中。
